name: @wazir/desktop
description: Wazir Desktop — native shell around the Wazir API and web dashboard

wazir.excludeFromCliBuildReason: tauri build requires Cargo and network access to crates.io; the CLI never depends on it.

scripts.build: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); if (process.platform === 'linux' && spawnSync('pkg-config', ['--exists', 'dbus-1']).status !== 0) { console.log('[@wazir/desktop] Skipping native Tauri build on headless Linux (dbus-1.pc not installed)'); process.exit(0); } const res = spawnSync('npx', ['tauri', 'build', '--no-bundle'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.exit(res.status ?? 0);"
